en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Quran which Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> came with unto Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> was of seventeen thousand Verses’.
en.sarwar: 28. Ali ibn al-Hakam has narrated from Hisham ibn Salim from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
The Holy Quran that Jibril (Gabriel) brought to Muhammad (a.s.) had seventeen thousand verses.’”
